title: Splunk security advisory (AV26-1196)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1196 Date: November 23, 2026 As of November 19, 2026, Splunk is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Splunk Enterprise Prior to 10.6.1 Prior to 10.4.5 Prior to 10.2.9 Prior to 10.0.12 Prior to 9.4.17 Splunk Enterprise Security Prior to 8.7.0 Splunk App for PCI Compliance Prior to 8.7.0 Splunk SOAR Prior to 8.8.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
